"""Centralized constants for the entity placement page.

Per this package's `CLAUDE.md`, item roles, category keys, dialog sizes,
vector ranges and formatting parameters are collected here so the mixins and
the `EntityPlacementWidget` shell share a single source of truth instead of
scattering magic numbers across modules.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

# --- item roles -----------------------------------------------------------
# Custom Qt item-data roles (offsets above Qt.UserRole == 0x0100) used by the
# instance list. Kept as plain ints so this module has no hard Qt dependency.
_USER_ROLE = 0x0100

ROLE_INSTANCE_ID = _USER_ROLE + 0
ROLE_ENTITY_KEY = _USER_ROLE + 1
ROLE_IS_SHARED = _USER_ROLE + 2
ROLE_CATEGORY = _USER_ROLE + 3

# --- category keys --------------------------------------------------------
CATEGORY_LEVEL_ENTITY = "level_entity"
CATEGORY_DECORATION = "decoration"
CATEGORY_INSTANCE = "instance"

ALL_CATEGORY_KEYS = (
    CATEGORY_LEVEL_ENTITY,
    CATEGORY_DECORATION,
    CATEGORY_INSTANCE,
)

# --- dialog sizes ---------------------------------------------------------
# (width, height) in device-independent pixels.
DIALOG_SIZE_MERGE_DECORATIONS = (480, 360)
DIALOG_SIZE_INSTANCE_EDIT = (360, 280)

# --- vector ranges --------------------------------------------------------
# Inclusive placement bounds for a single position/scale component.
VECTOR_COMPONENT_MIN = -100000.0
VECTOR_COMPONENT_MAX = 100000.0

# --- formatting -----------------------------------------------------------
# Decimal places used when rendering vector components in the UI.
VECTOR_DISPLAY_PRECISION = 3

[pytest]
# Scope pytest to this snapshot (the parent pyproject.toml points testpaths at
# an unrelated experiment tree). Placing this ini here makes the scratch dir the
# rootdir so the entity_placement constants test is collected and run.
testpaths = tests
pythonpath = .

"""Pin the contract of the centralized entity-placement constants module.

The package `CLAUDE.md` states that item roles, category keys, dialog sizes,
vector ranges and formatting parameters are collected in `constants.py`. These
tests guard that centralization so magic numbers don't drift back into the
mixins.
"""

from app.ui.graph.library_pages.entity_placement import constants as C


def test_item_roles_are_distinct_and_above_user_role():
    roles = [
        C.ROLE_INSTANCE_ID,
        C.ROLE_ENTITY_KEY,
        C.ROLE_IS_SHARED,
        C.ROLE_CATEGORY,
    ]
    assert all(r >= 0x0100 for r in roles)
    assert len(set(roles)) == len(roles)


def test_category_keys_are_registered_and_unique():
    assert C.CATEGORY_LEVEL_ENTITY in C.ALL_CATEGORY_KEYS
    assert C.CATEGORY_DECORATION in C.ALL_CATEGORY_KEYS
    assert C.CATEGORY_INSTANCE in C.ALL_CATEGORY_KEYS
    assert len(set(C.ALL_CATEGORY_KEYS)) == len(C.ALL_CATEGORY_KEYS)


def test_dialog_sizes_are_positive_pairs():
    for size in (C.DIALOG_SIZE_MERGE_DECORATIONS, C.DIALOG_SIZE_INSTANCE_EDIT):
        w, h = size
        assert w > 0 and h > 0


def test_vector_range_is_ordered():
    assert C.VECTOR_COMPONENT_MIN < C.VECTOR_COMPONENT_MAX


def test_vector_display_precision_is_non_negative_int():
    assert isinstance(C.VECTOR_DISPLAY_PRECISION, int)
    assert C.VECTOR_DISPLAY_PRECISION >= 0
